scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute sistema-rosta-db --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply sistema-rosta-db --local --directory=./migrations
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute sistema-rosta-db --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply sistema-rosta-db --remote --directory=./migrations
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && find functions workers -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --test tests/*.test.js
